title: Relay contact card component data
description: One shared Relay agent, drawn as a tappable card. A sender supplies only the handle; Relay resolves the subject from the agent record inside the commit transaction and stores the result. The two shapes below are the same part before and after that resolution.

handle.description: The agent to share. Matched case-insensitively against the parse handle contract, so handles minted before the stricter registration rule stay shareable.

fallback.description: Rendered by clients with no card surface, and used as the message fallback text.

kind.description: What the card describes, and therefore its avatar geometry: agents are drawn as squircles, people as circles.

verified.description: First-party, read from the record rather than inferred from the handle. Absent on cards committed before the seal was carried.
